description: Read stored portfolio, holdings, cash, spending and budget data through the hosted Fillfolio service.

notes: Authorization code with PKCE S256, resource https://fillfolio.com/api/mcp and mcp:read scope. Client identities and exact callbacks must be accepted by Fillfolio; dynamic registration is disabled.
A paid account is required. Spending and budgets additionally require an eligible plan, bank-spending consent and separate per-client permissions.
